title: Shall Wisdom Cry Aloud
description: Shall Wisdom Cry Aloud in Tonic Solfa to FRANCONIA, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 8 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for his Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707), Book I, collected from the Scriptures, hymn 92, headed “Christ the wisdom of God, Prov. 8. 1 22-32”.
Watts' hymns were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Short Metre (6.6.8.6). This page sets the words to FRANCONIA; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Shall wis-dom cry a-loud And not her speech be heard? The voice of God's e-ter-nal word, De-serves it no re-gard?

lines: And not her speech be heard?
The voice of God's eternal word,
"Before the first of all his works,
"To order where the sun should rise,
"I gave the flood a firm decree,
"With joy I saw the mansion where
"Ere sin was born, or Adam's dust
"Happy the man that keeps my ways;

source: Isaac Watts, Hymns and Spiritual Songs (1707)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to FRANCONIA by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
